title: task-65-round-2-v2 normalized context input
description: Normalized context input produced by the Claude transcript adapter from INPUT_CONTEXT_BEARING records (attachments with file/listing/todo content, compaction summaries, prompts). Context inputs are content that entered the session without a tool call; the access audit matches them against the same Class 2 / Class 3 forbidden identifiers so contamination via attachment / summary / snapshot input is detected. Context inputs are audited, never a substitute for access events.
